A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the tolerances in IMRT QA should be based on the specific QA methodology and disease site.

the tolerances for the monitor unit and diode-array IMRT QA tests should be based on the disease site, and the tolerances for diode-array measurements should be based on a threshold in the gamma index analysis.
the IMRT QA process is more than just a series of tests, and the tolerances for each test must be defined with respect to the overall goal of delivering a safe treatment.
The main takeaway from our work is that
IMRT QA tolerances are best defined in terms of the expected performance of a given IMRT QA method, rather than a benchmark or threshold.
